description: This is a C# source file defining the UsersController class for handling user-related API endpoints in an ASP.NET Core application. It utilizes MediatR for command dispatching and provides routes for creating a user and logging in.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: A controller class handling user registration and login HTTP POST requests, delegating work to the mediator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new user, invoking mediator with Create.Command.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request for user login, invoking mediator with Login.Command.
